name: sudo, sshd or the keys of root changed
description: /etc/sudoers, /etc/ssh/sshd_config or /root/.ssh/authorized_keys has another SHA-256 than at the previous collection: who may become root and how one gets in. A key or a rule added by an attacker lives here.
remediation: Compare it with what you expect (the configuration management, the change that was planned) and look at the file.
